text:
telera-procurement: Hey team — Procurement at Telera. We can't accept the invoice you generated (INV-2026-0047) because our policy requires an official PO number printed on the invoice. Please hold final invoicing until we send the PO.pdf. Expect to get it over by Tue next week.

sara.support: Hi! Thanks for the heads up. We can hold final settlement — wanted to confirm whether you need a pro-forma invoice in the meantime or just the final invoice with the PO number?

telera-procurement: Just the final invoice with the PO number is fine. We need the invoice to contain our PO# and our billing address block. Procurement won't sign otherwise.

ajit.sales: @telera-procurement noted — cc'ing billing. We have the signed SOW and account info on file (ACC-7782). If it helps we can attach the pending PO to the order in our system once you send it.

kevin.billing: billing-bot: Invoice INV-2026-0047 status: PENDING_PO. We cannot finalize or send for collection until PO is attached.

kevin.billing: To speed this up: please email the PO PDF to billing@redwood.com with subject line exactly: "PO Telera - ACC-7782 - INV-2026-0047" and include the PO number in the body. Also include who should receive the invoice once finalized.

telera-procurement: Thanks — we'll email it. Quick Q: can you issue a pro-forma that we can attach to our internal system while procurement completes the PO? That would unblock internal workflows.

sara.support: Yes we can generate a pro-forma. It won't trigger payment collection — just a "pro-forma" PDF matching the invoice line items. I can drop that in this thread in a minute.

kevin.billing: I'll prepare the pro-forma and mark the real invoice as "awaiting PO". Once we receive the PO email we finalize the invoice, update the invoice number if needed, and send the signed copy. Typical turnaround after PO receipt is same business day.

telera-procurement: Appreciate it. We'll send the PO to billing@redwood.com today and cc: ajit.sales. Thanks all :pray:

ajit.sales: I'll follow up with procurement if we don't see the PO by EOD tomorrow. Thanks @kevin.billing and @sara.support :thumbsup:

sara.support: Noted — marking this thread as monitoring. Please post the PO email or the PO number here when sent so we can close out.

billing-bot: NOTE: Created task BL-4527 — wait_for_po for ACC-7782."
